incident_evidence.discarded_task_failure: balanced BCE rejected a train complex containing only the negative class

changes_only.autograd_saved_tensor_policy: offload every autograd-saved tensor to CPU until backward; forward values, loss, gradients, optimizer, and update order are unchanged
changes_only.training_output_retention: retain only tensors consumed by the registered objective; discard diagnostic/intermediate return values before backward
changes_only.binary_loss_for_one_class_complex: average BCE over classes actually observed in each complex; retain equal positive/negative weighting when both occur and use negative-only BCE when no positive contact exists

amendment.scientific_rationale: A genuine complex with zero stored contacts has no positive class to balance and must not receive a fabricated positive label. Saved-tensor offload and output pruning are numerical execution policies, not model or endpoint changes.

evidence_boundary_at_freeze.claim_downgrade: The SAbDab2 test remains prediction-frozen and selection-free but is not described as label-inaccessible because aggregate label-derived contact counts were inspected during runtime diagnosis.

training_objective.contact: observed-class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.specificity: mean softplus ranking loss over both reciprocal counterfactual directions
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong pairs are ranking examples and never receive fabricated all-zero contact labels

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum of the two validation cluster-weighted directional interaction-only margins; break ties within 0.0001 by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.reporting: report every seed and a frozen five-seed ensemble without suppressing failures

claim_boundary: This amendment was driven only by train-runtime failures and schema QC before any validation prediction. It does not authorize a validation, test, external, or benchmark performance claim.
